errors.text_span: „Übrige“ (grau) mit 38,1 % im Jahr 2014 und einem unklaren Prozentsatz im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The figure shows „Übrige“ as 31.1% in 2014 (inner circle) and 38.1% in 2021 (outer circle). The description incorrectly states 38.1% for 2014 and does not specify the correct 2021 value.
The figure labels this segment as „Wohnungswesen“ with 4.1% in 2014 and 7.2% in 2021. The description incorrectly names it „Wohnungsbau“ and reports an incorrect value of 13% for 2014.
The figure shows „Abwasserentsorgung“ as 10.2% in 2014 and 7.8% in 2021. The description incorrectly reports 7.3% for 2014.
The figure shows „Stromversorgung“ as 4.2% in 2014 and 8.9% in 2021. The description incorrectly reports 6.9% for 2014 and mislabels the color as hellgrün (it is dunkelgrün).
The figure shows „Wasserversorgung“ as 11.8% in 2014 and 8.8% in 2021. The description swaps the values, reporting 8.8% for 2014 and 5.5% for 2021 (5.5% is incorrect for 2021).
The figure shows „Verkehr“ as 4.4% in 2014 and 3.7% in 2021. The description swaps the values and incorrectly assigns the color gelb (it is grau).
The figure shows „Wirtschaftsförderung“ as 6.2% in 2014 and 4.7% in 2021. The description incorrectly reports 4.4% for 2021 and mislabels the color as olivgrün (it is hellgrün).
The figure shows „Kliniken“ as 4.5% in 2014 and 3.2% in 2021. The description incorrectly reports 4.1% for 2021 and mislabels the color as rosa (it is hellblau).

The description correctly reports the values for „Kultur“ but incorrectly assigns the color dunkelgrau (it is dunkelblau). The 2021 value for „Sport/Erholung“ (3.6%) is incorrectly attributed to „Kultur“.

errors.text_span: Das Diagramm besteht aus zehn Segmenten
errors.evidence: The figure contains 14 segments, not 10. The description omits „Abfallwirtschaft“, „Übrige Versorgung“, „Kombinierte Versorgung“, and „Sport/Erholung“.
The figure shows „Gasversorgung“ in schwarz, not dunkelblau. Dunkelblau is used for „Kultur“ and „Wasserversorgung“.

The description omits the segments „Abfallwirtschaft“ (4.0% in 2014, 3.4% in 2021), „Übrige Versorgung“ (1.4% in 2014, 1.3% in 2021), „Kombinierte Versorgung“ (6.2% in 2014, 5.5% in 2021), and „Sport/Erholung“ (2.4% in 2014, 3.6% in 2021).

The reference description explicitly states the chart shows „relative Anteile verschiedener Bereiche“ (relative shares of different sectors), which is more precise than „relative Ausgaben“ (relative expenditures). The machine-generated description does not fully capture this nuance.
The description does not explicitly mention that the inner circle represents 2014 and the outer circle represents 2021, though this is implied. The reference description makes this distinction clear.

errors.text_span: und einem ähnlichen Anteil im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The phrase „ähnlicher Anteil“ is vague and appears multiple times. The exact values for 2021 are visible in the figure and should be reported precisely.
